text:
Jamal: Customer (NovoHealth) emailed: dashboard shows a month-to-date uptime shortfall but their internal logs show no errors. They want our timing window and credit calc before renewal.
Ayesha: Can you paste the dashboard link? Sometimes timezone rounding on the bill window causes apparent mismatch.
Jamal: Link: https://console.redwood/accounts/novohealth/slo. Our dashboard shows uptime 99.93% for Mar so far (SLO 99.95%).
Marco: Quick check: their telemetry agent was reporting in UTC-7; our billing window uses UTC. If their agent stopped shipping for ~3m around 2026-03-05T23:58-2026-03-06T00:01-0700 that maps to 2026-03-06T06:58Z-07:01Z and falls into midnight UTC billing boundary.
Tess: If the gap crosses the billing bucket boundary we round up differently, which can change the prorated minutes. We should surface both customer-local and billing UTC timelines in the evidence.
Jamal: Action items: 1) produce minute-level uptime for 2026-03-05 23:50-00:10 local (agent) and UTC equivalent, 2) compute credit using prorated-minutes method, 3) prepare 1-paragraph note for renewal call. Who takes 1/2/3?
Ayesha: I'll grab metrics and produce both timelines. Command I ran:
```
redwood-cli metrics get --account novohealth --metric uptime --range "2026-03-05T23:50:00-07:00/2026-03-06T00:10:00-07:00" --granularity 1m > novo-uptime.ndjson
```
Marco: I'll calculate credit. Quick formula I use: credit% = min(1.0, (SLO - actual_uptime)/SLO) * prorate_factor. For 2 minutes in 30-day month prorate_factor ~= 2/(30*24*60) = 0.000046.
Tess: I'll draft the customer note: 2 bullets: "what we saw" + "how we mapped windows" + credit estimate. Keep language simple and include both UTC and local times.
acct-bot: Evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-evidence/novohealth/3532109876-evidence.tar.gz (sha256: 8a7b2f0c). Ticket CS-5603 opened.
Ayesha: Uploaded both timelines and agent logs. Found agent restart at 2026-03-05T23:58:12-07:00 (corresponds to 2026-03-06T06:58:12Z).
Marco: Using prorated method, estimated credit ~0.9% of monthly invoice. I'll post calc in the ticket.
Jamal: Good. Tess, can you craft the line for the renewal slide: "We verified a short telemetry gap caused by agent restart; mapped across both timezone views; estimated credit ~0.9%; recommended joint sync to align agent clocks to UTC and add heartbeat alerts."
Tess: Drafted and uploaded to CS-5603. Will join the renewal call for the explanation.
Jamal: Thanks team. Closing once customer ack's note.
Tess: :white_check_mark: will update thread after call.
